text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Takarazuka Kinen. Fine Motion hopes that her run today will leave a deep impression on everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion is struggling with her thoughts, so I tell her that she can just continue as she has been, considering it's her joyous running that her fans have come to love.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She takes my words to heart and heads off to the race, practically praying that people will remember her.
